ConnectorType.description: ConnectorType is one entry of connectors.json. Analog lists its analogue pins, of which the names starting with AQ or UA are outputs.

color.description: Color is how the wiring view draws the connector and its cables, as #rrggbb.

description: connectors.json: the types of connector, by name, with how many inputs and outputs they carry. Collections add theirs to the others'.
title: Connector types
